method: Read original arXiv records and primary paper text, official Qwen model card, and versioned TRL documentation. No secondary performance summaries are used as evidence.

entries.title: Stop Summation: Min-Form Credit Assignment Is All Process Reward Model Needs for Reasoning
entries.venue: NeurIPS 2025, as stated on the arXiv record
entries.supports: PURE uses min-form process credit assignment; our response-level minimum plus scalar GRPO is not its reproduction.

entries.title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
PRPO: Aligning Process Reward with Outcome Reward in Policy Optimization
entries.supports: Aligns fine-grained process and outcome training signals. External accuracy is not treated as a matched baseline.

entries.title: Measuring Mathematical Problem Solving With the MATH Dataset
LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
entries.supports: Low-rank adapter updates with frozen base weights.

entries.title: The Weakest Link Tells It All: Outcome-Supervised Process Reward Modeling via Learnable Credit Assignment
entries.supports: Softmax-weighted-sum pooling and stop-gradient weights inspire the C/D adaptation pilot. Not a full LCA reproduction.

entries.title: Let's Verify Step by Step
entries.supports: Outcome-versus-process supervision and human step labels.

entries.title: Understanding R1-Zero-Like Training: A Critical Perspective
entries.supports: Dr. GRPO identifies length normalization bias; our reported runs keep the grpo response-normalized loss.

entries.title: Process Rewards for Outcome-Guided Reasoning Steps in LLM Reinforcement Learning
entries.supports: PROGRS v2 centers incorrect-subset process rewards and keeps correct ones absolute. We do not adopt its unbiased-gradient claim.

entries.title: DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models
entries.supports: GRPO, critic-free group-relative advantages and clipped policy objective. Exact report reduction and epsilon match our pinned implementation, not all published variants.

entries.title: PAPO: Stabilizing Rubric Integration Training via Decoupled Advantage Normalization
entries.supports: Correct-subset process standardization differs from our raw bounded centering without process-std normalization.

entries.author: Hugging Face
entries.title: TRL v0.23.1: GRPO Trainer
entries.supports: The explicitly selected grpo loss has per-response token averaging; detached old-policy log probabilities and KL estimator. Access year is not asserted as software release year.

entries.title: Qwen2.5-Math Technical Report: Toward Mathematical Expert Model via Self-Improvement
The Lessons of Developing Process Reward Models in Mathematical Reasoning
entries.supports: PRM label/evaluation concerns and official double-newline step marker / positive-class scoring interface. Probability scores are not asserted to be calibrated correctness probabilities.

entries.title: ProcessBench: Identifying Process Errors in Mathematical Reasoning
entries.supports: Expert first-error annotation and valid-chain evaluation. 2024 is first arXiv year, not claimed conference year.

limitations: This is not an exhaustive literature review or a novelty certification.
Primary-source bibliographic checks do not establish absence of benchmark exposure.
